title: So‘zlashuv iboralari: tabiiy, lekin xavfsiz
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz kundalik suhbatda ishlatiladigan kamida 20 ta so‘zlashuv iborasini tanib, ulardan 10 tasini to‘g‘ri vaziyatda ishlatasiz, har biriga neytral muqobil topasiz, rasmiy vaziyatda nimani aytmaslik kerakligini bilasiz va boshqalarning gapiga tabiiy munosabat bildirasiz.

scenes.title: Bugun: jonli suhbat iboralari
board: Colloquial English (so‘zlashuv ingliz tili)
Spoken phrases · Neutral versions · Red flags · Reactions
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda onlayn muloqot va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar tilini o‘rgandik. Bugun yanada jonli mavzu: odamlar ofis oshxonasida, telefonda va do‘stlar bilan aslida qanday gapirishadi. Dars oxirida o‘nta tayyor iborani to‘g‘ri vaziyatda ishlatasiz, ularning neytral muqobilini bilasiz va rasmiy joyda nimani aytmaslikni ajratasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we’re looking at the English people really use in the office kitchen and on the phone, and how to use it safely.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingiz bilan! Bugun odamlar ofis oshxonasida va telefonda haqiqatan ishlatadigan ingliz tilini va undan xavfsiz foydalanishni ko‘rib chiqamiz.

scenes.title: Uslub zinapoyasi
board: formal → neutral → informal → slang
Would you care for a coffee? → Would you like a coffee?
→ Fancy a coffee? (informal)
Safe zone = neutral + light informal
scenes.say_native: Avval asosiy tushuncha: uslub zinapoyasi. Tepada rasmiy til, keyin neytral, keyin norasmiy, eng pastda slang, ya’ni ko‘cha jargoni. O‘zbek tilida ham “Marhamat, choy ichsinlar” bilan “Choy ichamizmi?” bir xil emas. Sizning xavfsiz hududingiz neytral va yengil norasmiy til. Slangni tushunish foydali, lekin noto‘g‘ri joyda u kulgili yoki qo‘pol eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Think of English as a ladder: formal at the top, then neutral, then informal, and slang at the bottom. Most daily conversations happen in the middle.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilini zinapoya deb tasavvur qiling: tepada rasmiy, keyin neytral, keyin norasmiy va eng pastda slang. Kundalik suhbatlarning aksariyati o‘rtada bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: 1-guruh: salomlashish va hol-ahvol
board: How’s it going? / How are things?
What have you been up to? (nimalar qilib yuribsiz?)
Not bad. / Can’t complain. / Pretty good.
What’s up? → Not much. You?

examples.t: How’s it going? — Not bad, thanks. Busy week.
examples.uz: Ishlar qalay? — Yomon emas, rahmat. Band hafta bo‘ldi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi guruh: salomlashish. Jonli suhbatda “How are you?” o‘rniga ko‘pincha “How’s it going?” yoki “How are things?” deyiladi. Javob ham qisqa: “Not bad”, “Pretty good”, “Can’t complain”. “What have you been up to?” esa “oxirgi paytlarda nimalar qilyapsiz?” degani. Bu savollar ma’lumot so‘ramaydi, ular suhbatni ochadi.
scenes.say: How’s it going? Not bad, thanks. How are things with you? Can’t complain. So, what have you been up to lately? Oh, work, mostly.
scenes.say_uz: Ishlar qalay? Yomon emas, rahmat. Sizda ishlar qanday? Shikoyat qilolmayman. Xo‘sh, oxirgi paytlarda nimalar bilan bandsiz? E, asosan ish.

scenes.title: 2-guruh: taklif va rozilik
board: Fancy a coffee? / Fancy grabbing lunch?
Sounds good. / Sure thing. / I’m up for it.
Count me in! ≠ Count me out.
Maybe another time. (muloyim rad)

examples.t: We’re playing football on Saturday. — Count me in!
examples.uz: Shanba kuni futbol o‘ynaymiz. — Meni ham qo‘shinglar!

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: taklif va rozilik. Britaniyada “Fancy a coffee?” yoki “Fancy grabbing lunch?” juda ko‘p ishlatiladi; “fancy” dan keyin ot yoki “-ing” keladi. Rozilik: “Sounds good”, “Sure thing”, “I’m up for it”. “Count me in” “meni ham qo‘shing”, “Count me out” esa aksincha. Muloyim rad etish: “Maybe another time”.
scenes.say: Fancy grabbing a coffee after work? Sounds good, I’m up for it. Quiz night on Friday? Count me in! Sorry, I can’t make it. Maybe another time.
scenes.say_uz: Ishdan keyin kofe ichamizmi? Zo‘r, men roziman. Juma kuni viktorina kechasimi? Meni ham qo‘shing! Kechirasiz, qatnasha olmayman. Balki boshqa safar.

scenes.title: 3-guruh: kuttirish va holatingiz
board: Hang on a sec. / Give me a minute.
I’m swamped. (juda bandman)
I’m knackered. (BrE) = I’m beat. (AmE)
I’m starving. (juda ochman)

examples.t: Hang on a sec, I’ll just finish this email.
examples.uz: Bir soniya, shu xatni tugatib olay.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi guruh: kuttirish va holatingiz. “Hang on a sec” va “Give me a minute” “bir daqiqa kuting” degani. “I’m swamped” ishim boshimdan oshib yotibdi. “I’m knackered” Britaniyada “holdan toydim”, amerikaliklar “I’m beat” deydi. “I’m starving” so‘zma-so‘z “ochlikdan o‘lyapman”, aslida “juda ochman”. Bularning hammasi do‘stlar va yaqin hamkasblar uchun.
scenes.say: Hang on a sec, I’m on the phone. Sorry, I’m swamped today. I’m knackered, I worked till midnight. Let’s eat something, I’m starving.
scenes.say_uz: Bir soniya, telefonda gaplashyapman. Kechirasiz, bugun ishim boshimdan oshib yotibdi. Holdan toydim, yarim tungacha ishladim. Biror narsa yeylik, juda ochman.

scenes.title: 4-guruh: fikr bildirish va yumshatish
board: I reckon… (BrE) / I guess… (AmE) = I think
To be honest, … / If you ask me, …
kind of / sort of (biroz, qaysidir ma’noda)
Fair enough. (mayli, mantiqli)

examples.t: I can’t come, my sister’s visiting. — Fair enough.
examples.uz: Kelolmayman, opam mehmonga keladi. — Mayli, tushunarli.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi guruh: fikr bildirish. “I reckon” Britaniyada “menimcha”, amerikaliklar ko‘proq “I guess” deydi. “To be honest” va “If you ask me” fikrni ochiqroq aytadi. “Kind of” va “sort of” yumshatadi: “It’s kind of expensive”, ya’ni “biroz qimmatroq”. “Fair enough” esa kimdir sabab aytganda “mayli, tushunarli” degan javob.
scenes.say: I reckon the new system will save time. To be honest, I’m not a big fan. It’s kind of complicated. I can’t join, I’ve got a deadline. Fair enough.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, yangi tizim vaqtni tejaydi. Rostini aytsam, uni unchalik yoqtirmayman. U biroz murakkab. Qo‘shila olmayman, muddatim bor. Mayli, tushunarli.

scenes.title: Frazali fe’llar: jonli nutqning yuragi
board: sort out = solve / organise
catch up = meet and talk after a long time
grab (lunch) · drop by · figure out
Speech prefers short phrasal verbs

examples.t: Let’s catch up over lunch next week.

scenes.say_native: Jonli nutqning yuragi frazali fe’llar. Yozma rasmiy matnda “resolve” deyilsa, og‘zaki nutqda “sort out” deyiladi. “Catch up” uzoq ko‘rishmagan odam bilan gaplashib olish, “drop by” qisqa kirib o‘tish, “figure out” tushunib yetish. “Grab” esa tez olish: “grab a coffee”, “grab lunch”. Ular qisqa va do‘stona eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Don’t worry, I’ll sort it out. Let’s catch up soon. I’m going to grab a sandwich. I can’t figure out this spreadsheet. Drop by if you need anything.
scenes.say_uz: Xavotir olmang, men buni hal qilaman. Tez orada uchrashib gaplashaylik. Sendvich olib kelaman. Bu jadvalni tushuna olmayapman. Biror narsa kerak bo‘lsa, kirib o‘ting.

scenes.title: Salomlashishdagi tarjima xatolari
board: ✗ What’s up? — I’m fine, thank you. ✓ Not much. You?
✗ How’s it going? — Normal. ✓ Not bad. / All good.
✗ Let’s drink tea. ✓ Fancy a cup of tea?
✗ Thanks! — Nothing. ✓ No worries. / You’re welcome.
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. “What’s up?” ga “I’m fine, thank you” deyish g‘alati: bu “nima gaplar?” degani, javob “Not much, you?”. Rus tilidagi “нормально” dan “Normal” ham noto‘g‘ri, inglizcha “Not bad” yoki “All good”. “Let’s drink tea” buyruqdek eshitiladi. “Arzimaydi” ni tarjima qilib “Nothing” deyish esa umuman tushunarsiz.
scenes.say: What’s up? Not much, you? How’s it going? All good, thanks. Fancy a cup of tea? Thanks for your help! No worries.
scenes.say_uz: Nima gaplar? Hech narsa, o‘zingizda-chi? Ishlar qalay? Hammasi yaxshi, rahmat. Bir piyola choy ichamizmi? Yordamingiz uchun rahmat! Arzimaydi.

scenes.title: Mashq: tabiiy javobni tanlang
board: 1 What’s up? — a) I’m fine, thank you. b) Not much. You?
2 Fancy lunch? — a) Sounds good! b) Yes, I fancy.
3 Thanks a lot! — a) Nothing. b) No worries.
4 I can’t come, I’m ill. — a) Fair enough. b) Tell me about it.
scenes.say_native: Doskada to‘rtta qisqa vaziyat. Har birida a yoki b ni tanlang: qaysi javob tabiiy eshitiladi? To‘rtinchisida “Tell me about it” ning ma’nosini hali o‘rganmadik, taxmin qilib ko‘ring. Javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the most natural reply. What’s up? Fancy lunch? Thanks a lot! I can’t come, I’m ill.
scenes.say_uz: Eng tabiiy javobni tanlang. Nima gaplar? Tushlik qilamizmi? Katta rahmat! Kelolmayman, kasalman.

scenes.title: Javoblar: b, a, b, a
board: 1 b) Not much. You?
2 a) Sounds good! (✗ Yes, I fancy.)
3 b) No worries.
4 a) Fair enough.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “Not much. You?”. Ikkinchi: “Sounds good!”; “Yes, I fancy” deyilmaydi. Uchinchi: “No worries”. To‘rtinchi: “Fair enough”, chunki odam asosli sabab aytdi. “Tell me about it” esa “men ham shuni boshdan kechiryapman” degani, kasal odamga bunday deyish noo‘rin.
scenes.say: What’s up? Not much. You? Fancy lunch? Sounds good! Thanks a lot! No worries. I can’t come, I’m ill. Fair enough, get well soon.
scenes.say_uz: Nima gaplar? Hech narsa. O‘zingizda-chi? Tushlik qilamizmi? Zo‘r! Katta rahmat! Arzimaydi. Kelolmayman, kasalman. Tushunarli, tezroq tuzalib keting.

scenes.title: Norasmiy va neytral juftliklar
board: Fancy a coffee? → Would you like a coffee?
I reckon… → I think… / In my view…
I’m swamped. → I’m very busy at the moment.
Hang on a sec. → One moment, please.

examples.t: I’m afraid I’m very busy at the moment.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi asosiy mavzu: har bir norasmiy iboraning neytral jufti. Bu kiyimga o‘xshaydi: do‘stlar bilan sport kiyimda, mijoz bilan kostyumda bo‘lasiz. “Fancy a coffee?” neytralda “Would you like a coffee?”. “I reckon” o‘rniga “I think” yoki “In my view”. “I’m swamped” o‘rniga “I’m very busy at the moment”, “Hang on a sec” o‘rniga “One moment, please”.
scenes.say: Fancy a coffee? Would you like a coffee? I reckon it’ll work. I think it will work. Hang on a sec. One moment, please.
scenes.say_uz: Kofe ichamizmi? Kofe ichasizmi? Menimcha, bu ishlaydi. O‘ylaymanki, bu ishlaydi. Bir soniya. Bir daqiqa, iltimos.

scenes.title: Yana juftliklar: so‘z darajasida
board: sort out → deal with / resolve
loads of / tons of → a lot of / a number of
a bit → slightly · kids → children
Hi guys → Hello everyone

examples.t: We’ve had loads of complaints. → We’ve received a number of complaints.
examples.uz: Bizga juda ko‘p shikoyat keldi. → Bizga bir qator shikoyatlar kelib tushdi.

scenes.say_native: Farq alohida so‘zlarda ham bor. “Loads of” va “tons of” neytralda “a lot of”, rasmiyroq “a number of”. “A bit” o‘rniga “slightly”, “kids” o‘rniga “children”. “Hi guys” do‘stlar uchun yaxshi, rasmiy yig‘ilishda esa “Hello everyone”. “Sort out” o‘rniga “deal with”, yozma matnda “resolve”.
scenes.say: We’ve had loads of complaints. We have received a number of complaints. Hi guys! Hello everyone, and thank you for coming.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga juda ko‘p shikoyat keldi. Bizga bir qator shikoyatlar kelib tushdi. Salom, do‘stlar! Hammaga salom, kelganingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Bitta iltimos, uch xil uslub
board: Friend: Can you send it over?
Colleague: Could you send it to me when you get a chance?
Client: Would you be able to send it by Friday?
scenes.say_native: Uslubni tanlashda asosiy savol: kim bilan gaplashyapman? Do‘stga: “Can you send it over?”. Hamkasbga: “Could you send it to me when you get a chance?”. Mijozga: “Would you be able to send it by Friday?”. Gap uzaygani sari muloyimlik oshadi. O‘zbekchada “-sangiz”, “-olarmidingiz” qiladigan ishni ingliz tili modal fe’llar bilan qiladi.
scenes.say: Can you send it over? Could you send it to me when you get a chance? Would you be able to send it by Friday?
scenes.say_uz: Uni yuborib yuborasanmi? Imkoningiz bo‘lganda menga yubora olasizmi? Uni jumagacha yubora olarmidingiz?

scenes.title: Uslublarni aralashtirish
board: ✗ Dear Mr Brown, hey, what’s up?
✓ Dear Mr Brown, I hope you are well.
✗ (to the directors) Hi guys, I reckon…
✓ Good morning, everyone. I believe…
scenes.say_native: Eng xavfli xato uslublarni aralashtirish. Xat “Dear Mr Brown” bilan rasmiy boshlanib, “hey, what’s up?” bilan davom etsa, o‘quvchi chalg‘iydi. Direktorlar kengashiga “Hi guys, I reckon…” deb murojaat qilish ham shunday. Boshida tanlagan uslubni oxirigacha saqlang. Norasmiylikka o‘tishni esa suhbatdosh boshlasa yaxshi.
scenes.say: Dear Mr Brown, I hope you are well. Thank you for your quick reply. Good morning, everyone. I believe we can increase sales this year.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob Braun, umid qilamanki, yaxshisiz. Tezkor javobingiz uchun rahmat. Hammaga xayrli tong. Ishonamanki, bu yil sotuvni oshira olamiz.

scenes.title: Mashq: neytral uslubga o‘tkazing
board: 1 Fancy a coffee?
2 I’m swamped this week.
3 Can you sort out the booking?
4 I reckon it’s a great idea.
scenes.say_native: Tasavvur qiling, bu gaplarni do‘stingizga emas, yangi mijozga aytyapsiz. Har birini neytral, muloyim uslubga o‘tkazing. Faqat so‘zni almashtirmang, “I’m afraid”, “Would you”, “please” kabi yumshatuvchilardan ham foydalaning. To‘rttala gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Make these sentences suitable for a new client. Fancy a coffee? I’m swamped this week. Can you sort out the booking? I reckon it’s a great idea.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarni yangi mijozga mos qiling. Kofe ichamizmi? Bu hafta ishim boshimdan oshib yotibdi. Bronni hal qila olasizmi? Menimcha, bu ajoyib g‘oya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: neytral variantlar
board: 1 Would you like a coffee?
2 I’m afraid I’m very busy this week.
3 Could you deal with the booking, please?
4 I think it’s an excellent idea.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. “Would you like a coffee?”. “I’m afraid I’m very busy this week”, bu yerda “I’m afraid” noxush xabarni yumshatadi. “Could you deal with the booking, please?”. “I think it’s an excellent idea”. Sizning variantingiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi slang ham, ortiqcha norasmiylik ham yo‘q.
scenes.say: Would you like a coffee? I’m afraid I’m very busy this week. Could you deal with the booking, please? I think it’s an excellent idea.
scenes.say_uz: Kofe ichasizmi? Afsuski, bu hafta juda bandman. Bron masalasini hal qila olasizmi, iltimos? Menimcha, bu a’lo g‘oya.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: ofis oshxonasida
board: Kate & Aziz, Monday morning
Why is Aziz tired? · What does Kate suggest?
What time will they meet? · The printer?
scenes.say_native: Endi tinglang. Kate va Aziz dushanba ertalab ofis oshxonasida gaplashyapti. Bu ikki yaqin hamkasbning tabiiy suhbati. To‘rt narsaga quloq soling: Aziz nega charchagan, Kate nima taklif qiladi, ular soat nechada uchrashadi va printer haqida Aziz nima deb o‘ylaydi.
scenes.say: Kate: Morning, Aziz! How’s it going? Aziz: Not bad, thanks. A bit knackered, to be honest. I’ve been swamped all week. Kate: Tell me about it. Fancy grabbing a coffee after the meeting? Aziz: Sounds good. Hang on a sec… I’ve got a call at eleven. Can we make it half eleven? Kate: Fair enough. By the way, did you sort out the printer? Aziz: Kind of. I reckon it needs a new part. Kate: Oh, that’s a shame. See you at half eleven, then. Aziz: Cheers!
scenes.say_uz: Kate: Xayrli tong, Aziz! Ishlar qalay? Aziz: Yomon emas, rahmat. Rostini aytsam, biroz charchaganman. Butun hafta ishim boshimdan oshib yotdi. Kate: Menda ham shunday. Yig‘ilishdan keyin kofe ichamizmi? Aziz: Zo‘r. Bir soniya… Soat o‘n birda qo‘ng‘irog‘im bor. O‘n bir yarimda bo‘lsa-chi? Kate: Mayli. Aytgancha, printerni tuzatdingmi? Aziz: Qisman. Menimcha, unga yangi detal kerak. Kate: Attang. Unda o‘n bir yarimda ko‘rishamiz. Aziz: Rahmat!

scenes.title: Mashq: dialog 1 savollari
board: 1 Why is Aziz tired?
2 What does Kate suggest?
3 What time will they meet?
4 What’s wrong with the printer?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga inglizcha qisqa javob bering. Uchinchi savolda ehtiyot bo‘ling: Aziz “half eleven” dedi. Bu Britaniyacha ifoda, uni o‘zbekchadagi “o‘n yarim” bilan adashtirmang. O‘ylab ko‘ring: “half” qaysi soatga qo‘shilyapti? Javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions. Be careful with the time.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Vaqtga ehtiyot bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 1
board: 1 He’s been swamped all week.
2 Coffee after the meeting.
3 At half eleven = 11:30 (BrE)
4 It probably needs a new part.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Aziz butun hafta juda band bo‘lgani uchun charchagan. Kate yig‘ilishdan keyin kofe taklif qiladi. Ular 11:30 da uchrashadi: Britaniyada “half eleven” “o‘n birdan yarim o‘tdi” degani, uni 10:30 deb tushunmang. Printerga yangi detal kerak. Kate ning “Tell me about it” iborasi esa “men ham juda bandman” ma’nosida.
scenes.say: He’s been swamped all week. Kate suggests a coffee. They’ll meet at half eleven, that’s eleven thirty. The printer needs a new part.
scenes.say_uz: Uning butun hafta ishi boshidan oshib yotgan. Kate kofe taklif qiladi. Ular o‘n bir yarimda, ya’ni 11:30 da uchrashadi. Printerga yangi detal kerak.

scenes.title: Rasmiy joyda “qizil chiroq” so‘zlar
board: Slang: lit, sus, dude, bro
Rude: bloody, That sucks (avoid!)
Text-speak: u, pls, tbh, lol
Reduced forms in writing: gonna, wanna, gotta
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: rasmiy vaziyatda nima ishlatilmaydi. To‘rt guruh “qizil chiroq”. Slang: “lit”, “sus”, “dude”, “bro”. Qo‘pol iboralar: hatto “bloody” yoki “That sucks” ham intervyu va mijoz bilan suhbatda noo‘rin. Chat qisqartmalari: “u”, “pls”, “tbh”, “lol”. Va yozuvdagi “gonna”, “wanna”. Filmlarda ko‘p eshitasiz, lekin o‘zingiz ishlatishga shoshilmang.
scenes.say: In an interview, a meeting or a client email, avoid slang, rude words, text-speak, and gonna or wanna. Understand them, but don’t use them there.
scenes.say_uz: Intervyuda, yig‘ilishda yoki mijozga xatda slang, qo‘pol so‘zlar, chat qisqartmalari, gonna yoki wanna dan qoching. Ularni tushuning, lekin u yerda ishlatmang.

scenes.title: Gonna, wanna, gotta: qachon mumkin?
board: gonna = going to (+ verb only!)
wanna = want to · gotta = have got to
✓ I’m gonna call him. ✗ I’m gonna the office.
Speech: OK · Formal writing: never
scenes.say_native: “Gonna”, “wanna”, “gotta” tez nutqdagi qisqargan talaffuz. “Gonna” faqat “going to + fe’l” o‘rnida keladi. “I’m going to the office” da esa “going to” harakat, ya’ni “ofisga ketyapman”, shuning uchun “gonna” bo‘lmaydi. Og‘zaki nutqda bu shakllar tabiiy, lekin xat, hisobot va imtihon inshosida faqat to‘liq shakl yoziladi.
scenes.say: I’m gonna call him later. In writing: I’m going to call him later. I wanna leave early. In writing: I want to leave early.
scenes.say_uz: Keyinroq unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Yozuvda to‘liq shakl. Ertaroq ketmoqchiman. Yozuvda ham to‘liq shakl.

scenes.title: Intervyu va rasmiy xatdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Yeah, I’m kinda good at Excel, like, really.
✓ Yes, I’d say Excel is one of my strengths.
✗ Hey, wanna meet tmrw? (to a professor)
✓ Would it be possible to meet tomorrow?
scenes.say_native: Ikki real xato. Ish suhbatida: “Yeah, I’m kinda good at Excel, like, really”. Bir gapda “yeah”, “kinda” va “like” bor, nomzod ishonchsiz ko‘rinadi. To‘g‘risi: “Yes, I’d say Excel is one of my strengths”. Professorga xatda: “Hey, wanna meet tmrw?”. To‘g‘risi: “Would it be possible to meet tomorrow?”.
scenes.say: Yes, I’d say Excel is one of my strengths. I use it every day for reports. Dear Professor Smith, would it be possible to meet tomorrow?
scenes.say_uz: Ha, aytishim mumkinki, Excel kuchli tomonlarimdan biri. Undan har kuni hisobotlar uchun foydalanaman. Hurmatli professor Smit, ertaga uchrashish imkoni bormi?

scenes.title: Mashq: ish suhbatida svetofor
board: 1 Yeah, I reckon I’m pretty good with people.
2 Could you bear with me for a moment?
3 My last job was kinda boring, tbh.
4 Sorry, could you say that again?
scenes.say_native: Siz ish suhbatidasiz. To‘rtta gapga rang bering: yashil, ya’ni bemalol aytish mumkin; sariq, ya’ni yaxshilash kerak; qizil, ya’ni aytmang. Sariq va qizil gaplarni neytral uslubda qayta ayting. “Bear with me” iborasi yangi bo‘lishi mumkin, ma’nosini kontekstdan taxmin qiling.
scenes.say: You’re in a job interview. Read the four sentences. Is each one green, yellow or red?
scenes.say_uz: Siz ish suhbatidasiz. To‘rtta gapni o‘qing. Har biri yashilmi, sariqmi yoki qizilmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: sariq, yashil, qizil, yashil
board: 1 yellow → Yes, I’d say I’m good with people.
2 green: bear with me = please wait (polite)
3 red → My last role was less challenging.
4 green: polite and natural
scenes.say_native: Birinchisi sariq: “Yeah” va “I reckon” biroz bo‘sh, “Yes, I’d say I’m good with people” yaxshiroq. Ikkinchisi yashil: “bear with me” “biroz kutib turing” degani va muloyim. Uchinchisi qizil: oldingi ishni “boring” deb yomonlash, ustiga “kinda” va “tbh”. To‘rtinchisi yashil: tushunmasangiz, so‘rash normal.
scenes.say: Yes, I’d say I’m good with people. My last role was less challenging, so I’m looking for more responsibility.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, aytishim mumkinki, odamlar bilan yaxshi ishlayman. Oldingi lavozimim kamroq qiyinchilik talab qilardi, shuning uchun ko‘proq mas’uliyat izlayapman.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: bir odam, ikki uslub
board: Aziz: a call with a client, then Kate
What does he promise the client?
How does he change his language?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Aziz avval mijoz janob Harris bilan telefonda gaplashadi, keyin go‘shakni qo‘yib, Kate ga yangilikni aytadi. Bir odam besh soniyada uslubini qanday o‘zgartirishiga e’tibor bering. Aziz mijozga nima va’da beradi va mijoz nima so‘raydi?
scenes.say: Aziz: Good morning, Mr Harris. Thank you for calling. Certainly, I’ll look into it and get back to you by the end of the day. Would that be all right? Not at all. Goodbye. Kate, you won’t believe this! They want the whole report by tomorrow. Kate: No way! Seriously? Aziz: Yeah. I’m gonna need loads of help with the figures. Kate: No worries, count me in. Let’s grab a coffee and sort it out.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz: Xayrli tong, janob Harris. Qo‘ng‘iroq qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Albatta, buni o‘rganib chiqaman va kun oxirigacha sizga javob beraman. Shunday bo‘lsa ma’qulmi? Arzimaydi. Xayr. Kate, ishonmaysan! Butun hisobotni ertagacha so‘rashyapti. Kate: Bo‘lishi mumkin emas! Rostdanmi? Aziz: Ha. Raqamlar bo‘yicha menga juda ko‘p yordam kerak bo‘ladi. Kate: Hechqisi yo‘q, men qo‘shilaman. Kofe olib, buni hal qilamiz.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialog 2 savollari
board: 1 What does Aziz promise Mr Harris?
2 What does the client want?
3 How does Aziz reply to “thank you”?
4 Find two informal phrases with Kate.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi ikkitasi mazmun haqida. Uchinchisi nozik: mijoz rahmat aytganda, Aziz rasmiy uslubda qaysi ibora bilan javob berdi? To‘rtinchisi uchun Kate bilan suhbatdan kamida ikkita norasmiy iborani toping. Javoblarni inglizcha ayting.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions on the board.
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi to‘rtta savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 2
board: 1 to get back to him by the end of the day
2 the whole report by tomorrow
3 Not at all. (formal) ≈ No worries. (informal)
4 No way! · gonna · loads of · count me in
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Aziz kun oxirigacha javob berishni va’da qiladi: “get back to you” ish muloqotidagi juda foydali neytral ibora. Mijoz butun hisobotni ertagacha so‘rayapti. Rahmatga Aziz “Not at all” deydi, bu muloyim va biroz rasmiy. Kate bilan esa boshqa til: “No way!”, “gonna”, “loads of”, “count me in”. Ikkala uslub ham to‘g‘ri, faqat o‘z joyida.
scenes.say: He promises to get back to Mr Harris by the end of the day. The client wants the whole report by tomorrow. He answers thanks with not at all. With Kate, he switches to informal English.
scenes.say_uz: U janob Harrisga kun oxirigacha javob berishni va’da qiladi. Mijoz butun hisobotni ertagacha istaydi. Rahmatga u “not at all” deb javob beradi. Kate bilan esa norasmiy ingliz tiliga o‘tadi.

scenes.title: Tabiiy munosabat: to‘rt xil vaziyat
board: Surprise: No way! / Seriously? / You’re kidding!
Good news: That’s brilliant! / Good for you!
Bad news: Oh no, that’s a shame. / Poor you.
Agreement: Tell me about it! / Absolutely.

examples.t: My flight was cancelled. — Oh no, that’s a shame.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi asosiy mavzu: tabiiy munosabat. Suhbatdosh nimadir aytganda jim tursangiz, u sizni qiziqmayapti deb o‘ylaydi. Hayrat: “No way!”, “Seriously?”, “You’re kidding!”. Xushxabar: “That’s brilliant!”, “Good for you!”. Yomon xabar: “Oh no, that’s a shame”, yaqin odamga “Poor you”. Kuchli rozilik: “Tell me about it!” va “Absolutely”.
scenes.say: I’ve just been promoted! No way! That’s brilliant, good for you! My laptop died this morning. Oh no, poor you. These meetings are so long. Tell me about it!
scenes.say_uz: Hozirgina lavozimim oshirildi! Nahotki! Zo‘r, tabriklayman! Bugun ertalab noutbukim buzildi. Voy, bechora. Bu yig‘ilishlar juda uzun. O‘zim ham shunday deyman!

scenes.title: Me too, me neither, so do I
board: I love coffee. — Me too. / So do I.
I don’t like meetings. — Me neither. / Neither do I.
I’m not ready. — Neither am I.
I’ve been there. — So have I.

examples.t: I went to Samarkand last year. — So did I!
examples.uz: O‘tgan yili Samarqandga borgandim. — Men ham!

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “men ham” bitta, inglizchada esa gap tasdiq yoki inkorligiga qarab o‘zgaradi. Tasdiqqa “Me too” yoki “So do I”. Inkorga “Me neither” yoki “Neither do I”. “So” va “neither” dan keyingi yordamchi fe’l asl gapga mos keladi: “am”, “can”, “have”, “did”. “So did I” o‘tgan zamonda, “So have I” present perfect da.
scenes.say: I love working from home. So do I. I don’t like long meetings. Neither do I. I’m not a morning person. Neither am I. I went to Samarkand last year. So did I!
scenes.say_uz: Uydan ishlash menga juda yoqadi. Menga ham. Uzun yig‘ilishlarni yoqtirmayman. Men ham. Men ertalabki odam emasman. Men ham. O‘tgan yili Samarqandga borgandim. Men ham!

scenes.title: Mashq: so yoki neither?
board: 1 I can’t drive. — …
2 I’ve finished the report. — …
3 I was late this morning. — …
4 I don’t eat meat. — …
scenes.say_native: Tez mashq. Har bir gapga “men ham” ma’nosida qisqa javob bering, faqat “so” yoki “neither” bilan. Avval gap tasdiqmi yoki inkormi, aniqlang. Keyin asl gapdagi yordamchi fe’lni toping: “can”, “have”, “was” yoki “do”. Javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Agree using so or neither. I can’t drive. I’ve finished the report. I was late this morning. I don’t eat meat.
scenes.say_uz: So yoki neither bilan rozilik bildiring. Men mashina haydolmayman. Hisobotni tugatdim. Bugun ertalab kechikdim. Men go‘sht yemayman.

scenes.title: Javoblar: so va neither
board: 1 Neither can I.
2 So have I.
3 So was I.
4 Neither do I.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “I can’t drive” inkor va “can” bilan, demak “Neither can I”. “I’ve finished” tasdiq, “have” bilan: “So have I”. “I was late” o‘tgan zamon, “was”: “So was I”. “I don’t eat meat”: “Neither do I”. Har birida yordamchi fe’l egadan oldin turibdi. Shubha bo‘lsa, “Me too” va “Me neither” ham to‘g‘ri va xavfsiz.
scenes.say: I can’t drive. Neither can I. I’ve finished the report. So have I. I was late this morning. So was I. I don’t eat meat. Neither do I.
scenes.say_uz: Men mashina haydolmayman. Men ham. Hisobotni tugatdim. Men ham. Bugun ertalab kechikdim. Men ham. Men go‘sht yemayman. Men ham.

scenes.title: Munosabatdagi xatolar
board: ✗ I don’t like Mondays. — Me too. ✓ Me neither.
✗ My grandmother is in hospital. — Wow!
✓ Oh no, I’m sorry to hear that.
✗ So I do. ✓ So do I.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Inkor gapga “Me too” deyish: “I don’t like Mondays” ga “Me neither” kerak. Hamma narsaga “Wow!” deyish: “Buvim kasalxonada” desa, “Wow” beg‘am eshitiladi, kerakli javob “Oh no, I’m sorry to hear that”. So‘z tartibi: “So I do” emas, “So do I”, xuddi savoldagidek.
scenes.say: I don’t like Mondays. Me neither. My grandmother is in hospital. Oh no, I’m sorry to hear that. I hope she gets better soon. I need a holiday. So do I.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanbalarni yoqtirmayman. Men ham. Buvim kasalxonada. Voy, buni eshitib afsuslandim. Tezroq tuzalib ketishlarini tilayman. Menga ta’til kerak. Menga ham.

scenes.title: Mashq: tabiiy munosabat bildiring
board: 1 I’ve just been promoted!
2 I failed my driving test again.
3 Thanks so much for your help!
4 These traffic jams are awful.
scenes.say_native: Endi munosabatni o‘zingiz bildirasiz. To‘rtta gap eshitasiz. Har biriga bir-ikki so‘zli tabiiy javob bering: tabrik, hamdardlik, rahmatga javob yoki kuchli rozilik. Javoblarni darhol, xuddi jonli suhbatdagidek ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: React naturally. I’ve just been promoted! I failed my driving test again. Thanks so much for your help! These traffic jams are awful.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy munosabat bildiring. Hozirgina lavozimim oshirildi! Haydovchilik imtihonidan yana yiqildim. Yordamingiz uchun katta rahmat! Bu tirbandliklar dahshat.

scenes.title: Javob namunalari: munosabatlar
board: 1 Congratulations! That’s brilliant!
2 Oh no, bad luck! You’ll pass next time.
3 No worries! / You’re welcome.
4 Tell me about it!
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Lavozim oshganda: “Congratulations! That’s brilliant!”. Imtihondan yiqilganga: “Oh no, bad luck!” va dalda: “You’ll pass next time”. Rahmatga: “No worries” yoki “You’re welcome”. Tirbandlik haqidagi shikoyatga: “Tell me about it!”. E’tibor bering, har bir javob atigi ikki-uch so‘z, lekin suhbatni tirik qiladi.
scenes.say: Congratulations! That’s brilliant! Oh no, bad luck. You’ll pass next time. No worries, happy to help. Tell me about it! It took me an hour to get here.
scenes.say_uz: Tabriklayman! Zo‘r! Voy, omadingiz kelmadi. Keyingi safar topshirasiz. Arzimaydi, yordam berganimdan xursandman. O‘zim ham shunday deyman! Bu yerga kelishim bir soat oldi.

scenes.title: Tinglayotganingizni ko‘rsating
board: Right. / I see. / Uh-huh. / Sure.
Really? (↗ interest) · Really. (↘ flat)
That makes sense.
Hmm, I’m not so sure about that.
scenes.say_native: Suhbatdosh uzunroq gapirganda, inglizlar qisqa signallar bilan “eshityapman” deb turadi: “Right”, “I see”, “Uh-huh”, “Sure”. Ohangga e’tibor bering: ko‘tarilgan “Really?” qiziqishni bildiradi, pasaygani esa befarqlikni. Rozi bo‘lmasangiz, keskin “No” o‘rniga “Hmm, I’m not so sure about that” deng. Telefonda bu signallar ayniqsa muhim.
scenes.say: We moved the deadline to Thursday. Right. The client needs more time. I see, that makes sense. And we’re cutting the budget by half. Really? Hmm, I’m not so sure.
scenes.say_uz: Muddatni payshanbaga surdik. Xo‘sh. Mijozga ko‘proq vaqt kerak. Tushunarli, bu mantiqli. Va byudjetni ikki baravar qisqartiryapmiz. Rostdanmi? Hmm, ishonchim komil emas.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: tez nutqdagi qisqarishlar
board: Do you want to…? → D’you wanna…?
Let me → lemme · Don’t know → dunno
Hang‿on‿a sec · Not‿at‿all
Recognise them; use them only in casual speech
scenes.say_native: Endi talaffuz. Tez nutqda so‘zlar qo‘shilib ketadi. “Do you want to” “d’you wanna” bo‘lib eshitiladi, “let me” “lemme”, “I don’t know” esa “I dunno”. Undosh bilan tugagan so‘zdan keyin unli bilan boshlangan so‘z kelsa, ular ulanadi: “hang on a sec” bitta so‘zdek. Bu shakllarni avvalo tanib oling, aks holda filmlar va hamkasblarni tushunish qiyin.
scenes.say: Do you want to grab a coffee? D’you wanna grab a coffee? Let me check. Lemme check. I don’t know. I dunno. Hang on a sec. Not at all.
scenes.say_uz: Kofe ichishni xohlaysizmi? Kofe ichamizmi? Tekshirib ko‘ray. Tekshiray-chi. Bilmayman. Bilmadim. Bir soniya. Arzimaydi.

scenes.title: Mashq: soya bo‘lib takrorlang
board: Hang on a sec, let me check.
D’you wanna grab lunch?
Not at all. / No worries.
Really? ↗ No way! ↘
scenes.say_native: Bu mashqning nomi shadowing, ya’ni soya bo‘lib takrorlash. Har bir gapni eshiting va darhol o‘sha tezlik va ohangda takrorlang. So‘zlarni alohida aytmang, ularni ulang. “Really?” ni ko‘tarilgan, “No way!” ni pasayuvchi hayratli ohangda ayting. Ikki marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Hang on a sec, let me check. D’you wanna grab lunch? Not at all. No worries. Really? No way!
scenes.say_uz: Bir soniya, tekshirib ko‘ray. Tushlik qilamizmi? Arzimaydi. Hechqisi yo‘q. Rostdanmi? Bo‘lishi mumkin emas!

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tekshiring: ulanish va ohang
board: hang‿on‿a = one smooth unit
lemme check · wanna grab
Really? ↗ = interested
No way! ↘ = strong surprise
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. “Hang on a sec” bitta oqim bo‘lib chiqdimi? “Let me” “lemme” bo‘ldimi? “Really?” da ovozingiz oxirida ko‘tarildimi? Agar hammasi tekis ohangda chiqqan bo‘lsa, telefoningizga yozib oling va namuna bilan solishtiring. Keyingi darsda talaffuzni chuqurroq ishlaymiz.
scenes.say: Listen once more and compare. Hang on a sec, let me check. D’you wanna grab lunch? Really? No way!
scenes.say_uz: Yana bir marta tinglab, solishtiring. Bir soniya, tekshirib ko‘ray. Tushlik qilamizmi? Rostdanmi? Bo‘lishi mumkin emas!

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: uchta mini-dialog
board: A A colleague invites you to lunch, but you’re very busy.
B A friend tells you some bad news.
C Your manager thanks you for your report.
Use at least 6 expressions from today.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Uchta vaziyat bo‘yicha qisqa dialog tuzing. A: hamkasb tushlikka taklif qiladi, siz bandsiz va muloyim rad etasiz. B: do‘stingiz yomon xabar aytadi. C: rahbaringiz hisobot uchun rahmat aytadi, bu yerda uslub neytral bo‘lsin. Bugungi iboralardan kamida oltitasini ishlating va har bir dialogni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Your turn. Create three mini-dialogues: a lunch invitation when you’re busy, bad news from a friend, and thanks from your manager. Use at least six expressions from today.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizga. Uchta mini-dialog tuzing: band paytingizda tushlikka taklif, do‘stingizdan yomon xabar va rahbaringizdan rahmat. Bugungi iboralardan kamida oltitasini ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javob: uchta dialog
board: A Fancy lunch? — I’d love to, but I’m swamped. Maybe another time?
B I’ve lost my phone. — Oh no, poor you! Hang on, I’ll call it.
C Thanks for the report. — Not at all. Happy to help.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. A da “I’d love to, but…” rad etishni yumshatadi, “Maybe another time?” eshikni ochiq qoldiradi. B da “Oh no, poor you!” hamdardlik, keyin amaliy yordam. C da rahbar bilan neytral uslub: “Not at all. Happy to help.” Bu yerda “No worries, mate” xavfli. Dialoglaringizni solishtiring: iboralar o‘z vaziyatida ishlatildimi?
scenes.say: Fancy lunch today? I’d love to, but I’m swamped. Maybe another time? Fair enough! I’ve lost my phone. Oh no, poor you! Hang on, I’ll call it. Thanks for the report. Not at all. Happy to help.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun tushlik qilamizmi? Juda xohlardim, lekin ishim boshimdan oshib yotibdi. Balki boshqa safar? Mayli! Telefonimni yo‘qotib qo‘ydim. Voy, bechora! Shoshma, unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Hisobot uchun rahmat. Arzimaydi. Yordam berganimdan xursandman.

scenes.title: Xulosa: to‘rt qoida
board: 1 Learn phrases in groups: greet · invite · state · opinion
2 Every informal phrase → know its neutral twin
3 Red flags: slang · rude words · text-speak · gonna in writing
4 React: No way! · Poor you · Me neither · Tell me about it
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: iboralarni guruh bo‘lib o‘rganing: salomlashish, taklif, holat, fikr. Ikkinchi: har bir norasmiy iboraning neytral jufti bo‘lsin. Uchinchi: rasmiy joyda slang, qo‘pol so‘zlar, chat qisqartmalari va yozuvdagi “gonna” qizil chiroq. To‘rtinchi: suhbatdoshga tabiiy munosabat bildiring va inkor gapga “Me neither” deyishni unutmang.
scenes.say: You now know the key spoken phrases, their neutral versions, the red flags for formal situations, and how to react naturally to other people’s news.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz asosiy og‘zaki iboralarni, ularning neytral variantlarini, rasmiy vaziyatlar uchun qizil chiroqlarni va boshqalarning yangiligiga tabiiy munosabat bildirishni bilasiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: 10 expressions in 5 mini-dialogues
Underline each expression + write its neutral twin
Record yourself reading the dialogues
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bugungi o‘nta iborani tanlab, beshta mini-dialog yozing, har biri uch-to‘rt qator. Har bir iborani tagiga chizing va yoniga neytral juftini yozing. Keyin dialoglarni o‘qib, yozib oling. Mezon: o‘nta turli ibora, har biri o‘z vaziyatida, kamida ikkitasi munosabat iborasi. Keyingi darsda talaffuz klinikasida o‘zbek tilida yo‘q tovushlar, urg‘u va ohang ustida ishlaymiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: use ten expressions from today in five short dialogues, add a neutral version for each, and record yourself. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: bugungi o‘nta iborani beshta qisqa dialogda ishlating, har biriga neytral variant qo‘shing va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Keyingi safar ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Bugungi darsdan o‘nta so‘zlashuv iborasini tanlab, beshta mini-dialog yozing (har biri 3–4 qator: ish joyida, do‘stlar bilan, telefonda). Har bir iborani tagiga chizing va yoniga uning neytral juftini yozing (masalan, Fancy a coffee? → Would you like a coffee?). Dialoglarni ovoz chiqarib o‘qib, yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘nta turli ibora ishlatilgan, har biri o‘z uslubiga mos vaziyatda; kamida ikkitasi munosabat iborasi (No way!, Me neither, Tell me about it); gonna/wanna faqat dialog ichida uchraydi.

quiz.q: Your colleague asks “What’s up?”. Which reply is the most natural?
quiz.why_uz: “What’s up?” “nima gaplar?” degani; tabiiy javob “Not much. You?”. “Normal” rus tilidan tarjima.

quiz.q: Someone says “Thanks a lot!”. Which reply is wrong?
quiz.why_uz: “Nothing” — “arzimaydi” ning so‘zma-so‘z tarjimasi, ingliz tilida bunday javob berilmaydi.

quiz.q: “I don’t like long meetings.” — Choose the correct reply.
quiz.why_uz: Inkor gapga “Me neither” yoki “Neither do I” deyiladi; “Me too” faqat tasdiq gapga.

quiz.q: What is the neutral equivalent of “I’m swamped”?
options: I’m very busy at the moment.
quiz.why_uz: “I’m swamped” — “ishim boshimdan oshib yotibdi”; neytrali “I’m very busy at the moment”.
“Gonna” faqat “going to + fe’l” o‘rnida va “am/is/are” bilan keladi.
Britaniyada “half eleven” = o‘n birdan yarim o‘tdi, ya’ni 11:30. O‘zbekcha “o‘n yarim” bilan adashtirmang.

quiz.q: Which phrase is safest in a job interview?
options: My last job was kinda boring, tbh.
Yeah, I reckon I’m pretty good.
Could you bear with me for a moment?
quiz.why_uz: “Bear with me” muloyim va neytral; qolganlarida slang, chat qisqartmasi yoki ortiqcha norasmiylik bor.

quiz.q: A friend says, “These traffic jams are awful.” You strongly agree. You say:
quiz.why_uz: “Tell me about it!” — “o‘zim ham shunday holdaman” ma’nosidagi kuchli rozilik iborasi.

quiz.q: Your colleague can’t come to lunch because she has a deadline. A natural reply is:
quiz.why_uz: “Fair enough” — asosli sababni qabul qilganingizni bildiradi: “mayli, tushunarli”.

quiz.q: Choose the correct reply: “I’ve been to London.”
quiz.why_uz: Asl gap present perfect da (I’ve been), shuning uchun “So have I”: yordamchi fe’l egadan oldin.
